I am an old man now, sixty-three years, and this small maize plot behind the house is only a tenth of a hectare — too small for me to waste a whole bag of urea on it. I have other plots where I put my cash inputs; this one I intercrop with beans and pumpkins like my father did, and I put the kraal manure here because it is close to the house. The seed I save from last year's harvest — it germinates well and my wife knows how to cook it. At my age I cannot work like before, but my grown children help me weed when the rains come.
